summary: Tested Phase 1 (security) and Phase 2 (ZATCA Phase-1 invoices + inventory) on both backend and frontend. Backend: 25 pytest cases, 22 pass. Phase 1 works: draw auth codes 401/403/404, participant phones masked for the public, all 3 webhooks return 403 without the secret or with a wrong one, lockout gives 429 on the 6th try, cashier gets 403/200 as specified. I FIXED one serious security hole: a ?token= query parameter skipped the employee permission check (the cashier got 200 on /api/merchant/stats). Phase 2 works: business-profile validation, POS ignores client prices and rejects qty<=0, INV-xxxxxx numbers are sequential, hash chain links (previous_hash = prior invoice_hash), TLV QR tags 1-5 decode correctly, thermal/A4 print with QR and ?token=, customer gets 403 on another's invoice, stock decrements, online order invoice (tax=(sub+del)*0.15, order total == invoice total), /invoices/mine lists it, RMA refund creates a credit note (CN-, ref_invoice_number) and restocks. 3 failing tests are real bugs: (1) RMA inspection can be repeated (double refund, 2 credit notes, double restock), (2) RMA trusts unit_price/qty sent by the client, (3) POST /cart accepts negative quantities. Frontend: customer /invoices + inv-print work and draw-btn is hidden for customers. Merchant /merchant/invoices shows badges and the print-thermal/print-a4 buttons, which open HTML with QR. business-profile form loads with bp-* fields and saves (400 on bad VAT, 200 on a valid one). The cashier's More menu shows only POS/Invoices/Returns/Customers. Cashier business-profile screen spins forever (403). No deprecated Expo packages detected. All test data cleaned up (invoices/orders/rmas/wallet/stock restored, profile unchanged).

critical.issue: No state guard: calling disposition=refund again on an already 'refunded' RMA returns 200, credits the wallet again, issues a 2nd credit note and restocks again (verified: 2 credit notes, stock +2). Only allow inspection from 'approved' (or the pickup states). rma.py:373-452

unit_price and qty come from the client body (rma.py ~line 193: float(body.unit_price or product.price)); qty is not checked against the ordered qty. A customer can send unit_price=99999, qty=50 and the default approved_refund_amount follows. Use the order item's price/qty.

Accepts quantity <= 0 (quantity=-3 → 200). The order then gets a negative subtotal, while invoicing.ISSUE clamps qty to max(1,qty), so the order total and invoice total disagree. Validate quantity >= 1 (Pydantic Field(gt=0)). There is also no stock check on orders or POS (overselling allowed; stock just clamps at 0).

minor.issue: Refund amount is inconsistent: the default approved_refund_amount = product list price (199) ex-VAT, while the customer paid discount_price 179 + VAT = 205.85. The credit note then treats the amount as VAT-inclusive (net_unit = amt/1.15), so the credit note total is 199. Use the paid line total incl. VAT from the original invoice.

Lockout is an in-memory dict: it resets on restart, is not shared across workers, and is keyed only by phone, so anyone can lock a real user out for 15 min with 5 bad attempts. Store it in Mongo with a TTL and key it by phone+IP.
Per-line discount and extra discount from the client are not limited (a cashier can discount up to ~100%). Consider a max discount % or a 'discount' permission.

previous_hash is read (find_one sort seq -1) and the insert happens separately, not atomically. Two concurrent invoices can get the same previous_hash and break the chain. Look up by seq-1 after next_seq(), or serialize the steps.
TLV length is stored in one byte; a value over 255 UTF-8 bytes (long Arabic seller name) would corrupt the QR. Validate the length or truncate.
30 legacy seeded invoices have no invoice_number/VAT/qr/hash/lines.vat_amount. The list shows a blank number; the print shows no item rows and VAT 0.00. Migrate them or label them as legacy.

Not mapped in _PERM_MAP, so the middleware returns 403 for every non-'all' employee, but the screen is designed to be read-only for employees. Add a _PERM_ALT GET entry for {invoices,pos}, or hide the button for employees.
Mapped to the 'orders' perm, so the cashier (orders perm) can approve and refund RMAs (wallet credit + credit note). Confirm this is intended; consider a separate 'refunds' perm.

ui_bugs.issue: Cashier opening 'open-business-profile' gets 403 → infinite ActivityIndicator. Alert.alert is a no-op on web, so no error is shown.
Save success/400 error is shown only via Alert.alert, which does nothing on react-native-web, so web users get no feedback on an invalid VAT. Add an inline error/toast.

issues: WhatsApp button 29px and has no testID
Invoice number wraps onto 2 lines ('INV-' / '000013') because the badges crowd the row
In English mode the VAT label, total label, type badge and 'عرض / PDF' still show in Arabic (tSync not translated)
Uses hardcoded light colors (#FFF), so it ignores the theme/dark mode
Several labels stay in Arabic in English mode (note, Arabic name, VAT, CR, building no., street)

action_items: rma.py inspect_rma: reject (400) unless the state is 'approved' (or the pickup states); prevents double refund, credit note and restock
rma.py create_rma: take unit_price/qty from the order item and reject qty > ordered qty (minus already returned)
server.py CartItemInput.quantity: Field(gt=0, le=99); add a stock availability check in POST /orders (and optionally POS)
RMA refund amount/credit note: base them on the original invoice line (paid price incl. VAT) so the credit note matches the refund
Business-profile: add _PERM_ALT GET for {'invoices','pos'} or hide 'open-business-profile' for employees; add inline error/success (Alert is a no-op on web)
Login lockout: persist it in Mongo (TTL) and key it by phone+IP
Invoice chain: make the previous_hash lookup consistent under concurrency (use seq-1)
Print link: use a short-lived signed print token instead of the long-lived JWT in ?token=
Touch targets: print buttons >=44px; add a testID to the WhatsApp button; fix INV number wrapping; translate invoice labels in English mode
Migrate or label the 30 legacy invoices that have no ZATCA fields
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: enforce_employee_perms middleware only read the Authorization header, but get_current_user also accepts ?token=. The cashier got 200 on /api/merchant/stats?token=... (full bypass of employee permissions). The middleware now reads the token from either place.
server.py is ~6790 lines; it should be split into modules
RMA credit-note creation sits in a broad try/except that only logs, so a refund can complete without a credit note (ZATCA gap)
Order invoice creation also only logs a warning on failure, so an order can exist without an invoice

success_rate.backend: 88% (22/25; 3 failures are real bugs listed above)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested flows work; cashier business-profile spinner + design issues)

seed_data_creation: None left behind. Test invoices/orders/RMAs/loyalty/wallet txns were deleted, wallet balance and product stock restored, business profile unchanged (VAT 300000000000003). The invoice counter advanced to ~13 (expected: numbers never repeat).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_2_security_invoicing.py (it cleans up after itself). For UI: python /app/backend/tests/ui_seed_invoice.py seed|clean creates/removes one POS invoice linked to customer 0500000000. Lockout test uses phone 0599999990 (in-memory, resets on backend restart). Competition with entries: 6ab6206a71b6ad54069c12b5 (do not draw).
rca_of_issue: Employee-perm bypass: get_current_user falls back to request.query_params['token'] for browser-opened endpoints, but the middleware returned call_next() when no Bearer header was present. Repro: GET /api/merchant/stats?token=<cashier JWT> → 200. Fix: the middleware decodes the header token or the query token. Verified → 403.
